title: Manyhands JSON v1 identity preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of repo identity-set: what the repository's own Git configuration will hold, and the confirmation an execute of the same command, repository and input presents to write it. A prepare that gives no preview carries no preview data: a rejection, and a no-op for a repository whose own configuration already holds what is asked.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: The identity that will be written, and what is there now. The command writes the repository's own Git configuration and no other: not the global, the XDG or the system one. The repository need not be one Manyhands was enabled on.

root.description: The repository's root, as the request's records name it.

name.description: The name that will be written.

email.description: The email that will be written.

initials.description: The initials the repository's own configuration will hold: the ones the request sets, in lower case, or the ones it holds now when the request says nothing of them. Null when it will hold none: the request clears them, or says nothing of them and none are set.

current.description: What the repository's own Git configuration holds now. This is what the confirmation is for: a request whose repository holds anything else by the time it runs is external_change.

initials.description: manyhands.initials as it is written. It need not be initials a short code can be composed with.

effective.description: The identity a commit in the repository would carry now, with the level of Git configuration it comes from, and the initials a short code would be composed with. It is shown and is no part of what the confirmation is for.
